tokoh_utama: A 24-year-old Indonesian female receptionist with pulled-back dark hair in a neat ponytail, wearing a light blue medical clinic uniform with a white name badge pinned on her chest, tired eyes with subtle dark circles

part.pertanyaan: Yang kerja shift malam, pernah ngalamin hal aneh di tempat kerja? Cerita dong.
part.caption: Jangan pernah abaikan mesin antrean yang berbunyi sendiri saat tengah malam... #ceritahoror #hororindonesia

adegan.narasi: Di klinik tempatku jaga malam, ada nomor antrean yang dipanggil tiap jam nol: nomor nol.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a digital LED queue display board on a dimly lit hospital hall wall, showing glowing red numbers zero zero zero, cold blue eerie atmosphere.

adegan.narasi: Mesin antrean ini cuma punya tombol angka satu sampai sembilan puluh sembilan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a mechanical queue ticket printer machine on a wooden reception counter, physical buttons numbered 1 to 99 under dim light.

adegan.narasi: Aku selalu menempelkan kartu namaku di meja kasir tiap awal shift malam.
adegan.gambar: A female clinic receptionist attaching her plastic employee ID badge onto a desk near a computer screen in a quiet reception area.

adegan.narasi: Tepat jam nol nol nol nol, speaker di plafon mendadak berisik dan menyala sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Angle looking up at an old dusty ceiling speaker box inside a dark corridor, small indicator light flickering green.

adegan.narasi: Suara mesin otomatis berbunyi, "Nomor nol, silakan menuju ke ruang tiga."
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of empty clinic hallway with shadowy doors, cold fluorescent lights humming silently above.

adegan.narasi: Padahal ruang tiga sudah lama terkunci dan hanya dipakai sebagai gudang berkas.
adegan.gambar: A wooden door with a weathered metal plate marked Room 03, secured with a heavy rusted padlock and chain.

adegan.narasi: Aku mencoba mengecek layar monitor antrean, tapi angkanya tetap menunjukkan angka nol.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the receptionist leaning over her computer screen displaying glowing red queue log zero in a dark office room.

adegan.narasi: Angin dingin tiba-tiba berembus dari arah lorong ruang tunggu yang sepi.
adegan.gambar: Low angle view of dark empty clinic waiting area with rows of blue plastic chairs, curtains swaying gently from unseen breeze.

adegan.narasi: Aku berjalan pelan menelusuri deretan kursi plastik ruang tunggu yang terlihat kosong.
adegan.gambar: The receptionist walking slowly past empty blue plastic chairs. On the shiny tiled floor, beneath an empty chair, a distinct black shadow of a seated person is visible even though the chair is empty.

adegan.narasi: Bulu kudukku berdiri saat melihat sesosok wanita duduk menyendiri di sudut gelap.
adegan.gambar: Atmospheric shot of a pale woman sitting motionlessly in the farthest dark corner of the waiting room, wearing a faded traditional sarong batik dress.

adegan.narasi: Wanita itu perlahan menengadah sambil meremas kertas antrean berangka nol di tangannya.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of pale hands holding a crumpled thermal paper queue ticket printed with a bold black number zero.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau jadi aku, kamu antar ibu itu ke ruang tiga nggak?
part.caption: Ternyata nomor antrean nol itu bukan salah sistem... #ceritahoror #hororindonesia

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... Wanita misterius di ruang tunggu itu menatapku tajam di remang lampu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up face of a pale woman with sunken hollow eyes and pale lips looking directly up in dim light.

adegan.narasi: Dia memeluk erat buntalan kain tebal yang membungkus bayinya dengan sangat rapat.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the woman tightly cradling a thick dark floral cloth bundle in her arms, completely concealing whatever is inside.

adegan.narasi: Dengan suara bergetar wanita itu berbisik, "Dari tadi nggak dipanggil-panggil, Mbak."
adegan.gambar: Shot over the receptionist shoulder looking at the woman whispering with unnatural, motionless lips.

adegan.narasi: Tanganku gemetar mendingin, tapi aku tetap mencoba bersikap ramah padanya.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the receptionist shivering, clutching her clipboard tightly near her chest with pale nervous expression.

adegan.narasi: Aku mengambil keputusan membimbing wanita itu berjalan menuju pintu ruang tiga.
adegan.gambar: The receptionist walking along a dark hallway leading the ghostly woman who walks silently behind her.

adegan.narasi: Langkah kaki kami bergema pelan menyusuri lorong klinik yang makin dingin.
adegan.gambar: Low angle of two pairs of feet walking down the dark corridor, one pair wearing medical shoes, the other barefoot barely touching the floor.

adegan.narasi: Kunci besi gudang itu terasa membeku saat kuputar di lubang pintunya.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of receptionist key-holding hand unlocking an old brass keyhole on a dusty wooden door.

adegan.narasi: Pintu kayu berdecit keras saat kubuka, memperlihatkan tumpukan lemari tua berdebu.
adegan.gambar: Interior of a dark archive storage room filled with tall rusted metal cabinets. Deep between the narrow gap of two cabinets, pair of glowing yellow eyes stares back out.

adegan.narasi: Aku menyuruhnya duduk sebentar selagi aku memeriksa tumpukan arsip lama.
adegan.gambar: The receptionist opening a rusty filing cabinet drawer, shadows casting long ominous shapes across dusty floor.

adegan.narasi: Tanganku meraba menarik map berdebu bertuliskan tahun seribu sembilan ratus sembilan puluh delapan.
adegan.gambar: Hands pulling a thick yellowed paper folder labeled 1998 from a dusty metal shelf.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku berdegup kencang saat melihat nama pasien di map itu sama persis.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of an old patient record document inside the folder showing a faded photo of the exact same woman.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau namamu muncul di mesin antrean misterius, kamu bakal gimana?
part.caption: Jangan pernah biarkan nomor antrean nol memanggil namamu... #ceritahoror #hororindonesia

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... Dari lemari arsip tua, terungkap lembaran rekam medis pasien puluhan tahun lalu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up view of weathered hospital record page with handwritten black ink and stamped official seals.

adegan.narasi: Wanita itu dinyatakan meninggal di ruang tunggu akibat tidak kunjung dipanggil dokter.
adegan.gambar: Detail of the medical report document highlighting stamped words marked deceased in waiting room.

adegan.narasi: Rasa takut bercampur panik membuatku langsung berlari keluar menuju meja resepsionis utama.
adegan.gambar: The receptionist sprinting down the dark clinic corridor in total panic towards bright reception desk light.

adegan.narasi: Tanganku yang bergetar hebat segera menyalakan mikrofon pengeras suara di meja jaga.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of trembling hand turning on a black desk microphone switch on the reception counter.

adegan.narasi: Aku memberanikan diri memanggil nama lengkap wanita itu lewat pengeras suara klinik.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of receptionist speaking urgently into microphone, sweat on her forehead under dim desk lamp.

adegan.narasi: Setelah panggilan itu selesai, keheningan mencekam seketika melingkupi seluruh ruangan klinik.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of empty clinic lobby with silent ceiling lights, peaceful yet eerie atmosphere.

adegan.narasi: Panggilan otomatis nomor nol yang selalu terdengar tiap malam akhirnya berhenti total.
adegan.gambar: The receptionist sitting alone at reception desk looking at dark window glass. In the glass window reflection behind her, a tall dark silhouette figure is standing silently.

adegan.narasi: Aku menghela napas lega sambil merapikan kartu identitas kerja di atas meja.
adegan.gambar: Receptionist exhaling with relief, taking her employee ID card from the desk to put in her bag.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba mesin cetak antrean di sebelahnya berbunyi nyaring dan bergetar sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of queue printer machine suddenly whirring violently, spitting out a fresh paper slip.

adegan.narasi: Kertas berangka minus satu keluar, mencetak nama lengkapku yang terhubung dari kartu identitas.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of printed ticket paper showing bold text minus one followed by the full name of the receptionist.

adegan.narasi: Sebuah suara berbisik rapat di samping telingaku, "Sekarang giliranmu yang antre."
adegan.gambar: Dark chilling close-up shot of an eerie pale ghostly face leaning right behind the receptionist ear from dark background.
